title: Mochi and Oats Japanese Breakfast Bowl
description: A Japanese-inspired breakfast bowl with mochi, oats, and a hint of light flavor.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine glutinous rice flour and rolled oats.
Gradually add in water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten into discs.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Cook the mochi discs for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
In a separate saucepan, warm the light coconut milk over low heat.
Add sugar and green tea powder to the coconut milk and stir until dissolved.
To assemble the breakfast bowl, place a cooked mochi disc at the bottom, followed by a scoop of oats.
Pour the coconut milk mixture over the oats and top with another mochi disc.
